note: Domain weights reflect the skills-measured outline published on Microsoft Learn as of 2026-07-20. Always check learn.microsoft.com for the current official breakdown before your exam.

domains.name: Describe cloud concepts
subtopics: Cloud computing, the shared responsibility model, and the consumption-based model
Public, private, and hybrid cloud models with appropriate use cases
Benefits of high availability, scalability, reliability, predictability, security, governance, and manageability
Infrastructure as a service (IaaS), platform as a service (PaaS), software as a service (SaaS), and their use cases

domains.name: Describe Azure architecture and services
subtopics: Regions, region pairs, sovereign regions, availability zones, and datacenters
Resources, resource groups, subscriptions, and management groups — and their hierarchy
Compute: virtual machines, scale sets, availability sets, Azure Virtual Desktop, containers, and functions
Networking: virtual networks, subnets, peering, Azure DNS, VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute, public and private endpoints
Storage: services, tiers, redundancy, and tools for moving data (AzCopy, Storage Explorer, File Sync, Azure Migrate, Data Box)
Identity, access, and security: Microsoft Entra ID, MFA and passwordless, Conditional Access, RBAC, Zero Trust, defense in depth, Microsoft Defender for Cloud

domains.name: Describe Azure management and governance
subtopics: Cost factors, the pricing calculator, cost management capabilities, and tags
Governance and compliance: Microsoft Purview, Azure Policy, and resource locks
Managing and deploying resources: the portal, Cloud Shell, Azure CLI, Azure PowerShell, Azure Arc, infrastructure as code, and ARM templates
Monitoring: Azure Advisor, Azure Service Health, and Azure Monitor (Log Analytics, alerts, Application Insights)
